framework_name: Standardized IT Candidate Screening & Evaluation Rubric (S-IT-SR)
description: Universal 5-Pillar evaluation criteria benchmark used by global IT recruiters and HR professionals for objective technical profile screening.

evaluation_pillars.name: Core Technical Skills Match
evaluation_pillars.description: Evaluates the degree of alignment between candidate hands-on skills and job requirements.

sub_criteria.name: Must-Have Primary Technologies
sub_criteria.rule: Mandatory stack requirements (e.g. React, Java, AWS)

sub_criteria.name: Skill Depth & Version Recency
sub_criteria.rule: Evidence of modern version usage vs outdated syntax

evaluation_pillars.name: Relevant Experience & Seniority
evaluation_pillars.description: Evaluates tenure in relevant technical roles and hands-on depth.

sub_criteria.name: Years of Relevant Experience
sub_criteria.rule: Direct alignment with JD minimum years (Junior 1-2y, Mid 3-4y, Senior 5y+)

sub_criteria.name: Career Progression & Role Consistency
sub_criteria.rule: Continuity in technical positions without unexplained gaps

evaluation_pillars.name: Project Complexity & Architecture Contribution
evaluation_pillars.description: Evaluates scale, complexity, and tangible impact of completed software projects.

sub_criteria.name: High-Scale & Production Experience
sub_criteria.rule: Experience with microservices, high concurrency, cloud deployments

sub_criteria.name: Quantifiable Achievements
sub_criteria.rule: Mention of measurable improvements (e.g., reduced latency by 30%, handled 50k DAU)

evaluation_pillars.name: Database, DevOps & Cloud Foundations
evaluation_pillars.description: Fundamental engineering practices (Databases, CI/CD, Version Control).

evaluation_pillars.name: Education, Certifications & Communication
evaluation_pillars.description: Formal technical background, industry credentials, and professional communication.

sub_criteria.name: Degree / Formal Background
sub_criteria.rule: B.S./M.S. in CS/IT or proven equivalent self-taught track record

sub_criteria.name: Professional Certifications
sub_criteria.rule: AWS Certified, PMP, OCAJP, CKA, Scikit-Learn
